name: china-travel-assistant
description: Agent-invoked China travel Skill Plugin with OmniRoute exploration and exact visual itineraries.

interface.shortDescription: Eight Agent Skills for exact and imaginative China travel planning.
interface.longDescription: Use eight Agent Skills to compare domestic flights, China Railway services, hotels and transfers, explore unconventional OmniRoute combinations, verify pages through Ego Browser, and present exact facts through Visualize or local artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Use the China travel Agent Skills to compare total cost, time, fatigue, risk, and evidence.
Explore a Pro flight-train route while keeping a stable baseline.
Present the validated itinerary with Visualize or an exact local HTML fallback.
